reports.title: Universal Technical Institute Reports Fiscal Year 2026 Fourth Quarter and Year-End Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Financial Outlook
section: “Looking ahead to fiscal 2027, we expect revenue between $925 million and $945 million, while new student starts are expected to grow 9% at the midpoint,” continued Schuman. Our baseline adjusted EBITDA, excluding planned growth investments, is expected to be between $135 million and $141 million, while reported adjusted EBITDA is expected to be between $100 million and $106 million, inclusive of approximately $35 million of EBITDA impact due to growth investments in four planned new campus openings, new program launches and skilled trades capacity expansions, subject to required regulatory approvals. We view these as disciplined, high-return investments that will temporarily pressure margins while building meaningful earnings power for the years ahead. We will see these returns start to materialize in fiscal 2028, when we expect revenue of more than $1 billion and adjusted EBITDA approaching $150 million, and in fiscal 2029, we expect to surpass $1.2 billion in annual revenue with adjusted EBITDA approaching $220 million.”
